notes: Access: shop.vtwonen.nl reached directly via curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124 (Shopify store, robots.txt allows all, no Claude-specific disallow) per prior notes/112.md route. Checked full collections.json (1250 collections, 5 pages) for Dutch/English bestseller terms (bestseller, populair, meest verkocht, top). Found exactly one match: /collections/populair (title 'Populair'). Verified it is a genuine merchandising PLP, not editorial/PDP: it is promoted from the homepage via a dedicated banner with copy 'Shop de meest populaire keuzes van dit moment. Neem de tijd om onze absolute uitblinkers te bekijken en laat je verrassen door de mooiste items' (='Shop the most popular choices right now. Take time to view our absolute standouts...') linking to /collections/populair with CTA 'Shop ze nu'. The collection itself is a real filterable/browsable Shopify collection with normal product listing structure. Also checked site search (Searchanise API) for 'bestseller' - returned generic keyword-match results only (not a dedicated PLP), so not used as a separate finding. No other Bestsellers-type page (Top Sellers, Meest Verkocht, Trending) exists anywhere in the site's 1250 collections or main nav. Only one undifferentiated Bestsellers listing exists, so category=sub_category='Bestsellers'.

rows.evidence: Enumerated https://shop.vtwonen.nl/collections/populair/products.json?limit=250&page=1 -> returned exactly 71 unique product IDs on page 1 (< limit 250, confirming true last page reached, not capped).
